title: Teachers trained in ICT and agriculture skills
reason: This video describes an intensive two-day training program for teachers on information and communication technology and modern agricultural practices.

tasks.task: Describe the training program and its objectives.

subtasks.text: The training took place over two days at Isienodem Local Government Area in Aquabomb State, focusing on ICT and modern agriculture.
The program aimed to empower teachers to integrate technology into agricultural practices to enhance teaching methods and productivity.
Participants engaged in interactive sessions on digital farming techniques, mobile app usage for farm management, and online marketing strategies.

tasks.task: Highlight participants' experiences and reactions to the training.

subtasks.text: Teachers at the training expressed enthusiasm about learning new skills, including practical farming and trading techniques.
Participants noted that the training emphasized both theoretical and practical aspects, adapting to changes in teaching requirements.
Some attendees felt the training empowered them with innovative tools and techniques for marketing agricultural products.
The program also aimed to equip teachers with knowledge to share with peers and implement innovative practices in schools and communities.
